name: Log drum (FM woody walk)
desc: A talkative FM log drum: instead of a pitch glide, a sustained FM burst gives each note a woody, hollow knock, and the line walks melodically through D minor (d-f-a-c) rather than just bouncing octaves. Full is a rolling Dm-Dm-Bb-A walk with a filter tide and phrase fills; peak doubles the subdivision and floats an octave ghost over the top.

code.full: note("<[d2 ~ d2 f2 ~ a1 ~ d2] [d2 ~ d2 f2 ~ a1 c2 d2] [bb1 ~ bb1 d2 ~ f2 ~ bb1] [a1 ~ a1 c2 ~ e2 ~ a1]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${fmi}).fmh(${fmr}).fmattack(.001).fmdecay(.3).attack(.002).decay(.3).sustain(0).release(.08).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).lpq(3).shape(.35).gain(${gain}).room(.12).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[d2 f2 d2 f2 a1 c2 a1 d2] [d2 f2 d2 f2 a1 c2 d2 e2] [bb1 d2 bb1 d2 f2 a1 f2 bb1] [a1 c2 a1 c2 e2 g2 e2 a1]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${fmi}*1.3).fmh(${fmr}).fmattack(.001).fmdecay(.28).attack(.002).decay(.28).sustain(0).release(.07).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.8).slow(16)).lpq(4).shape(.4).gain(${gain}).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(${gain}*.35)).orbit(3).play()
